sections.content: Section 13 provides that copyright subsists in original literary, dramatic, musical and artistic works, including original translations, commentaries, and analytical compilations of classical Ayurvedic texts.

sections.section_title: Certain Acts Not to be Infringement of Copyright (Fair Dealing)
sections.content: Section 52 specifies acts that do not constitute infringement, including fair dealing for research, private study, criticism, or review of medical literature.
